senses.gloss_en: to sack (to put in a sack)
to fold, to welt, to groove, to crimp
to go mad, to go crazy
to blood (to cause to be covered with blood)
to grease or smear with tallow
self-absorbed, aloof, lost in one's thoughts
to make (someone or something) completely wet by having water or some other liquid fall or thrown on them or it — see also saturate, soak
to deafen (to make deaf, permanently or temporarily)
